beacon_block_header_encoder (iii).reason: INBOX 019 end condition: when the hold-out decoder (ii) is kernel-checked with its evidence, set in-review and end. (iii) is hand work (no encode mode) and is left to a later controller order after review.
beacon_block_header_encoder (iii).read_only_observation: Textual comparison (no proof attempt): the P2 encode template rootEncHead/rootEncTail (fixed registers, from Checkpoint.MarshalSSZTo) matches none of the three BBH root encode blocks. Root 1 (directives 62-89): the field pointer is loaded into rdx and the offset kept in r8 (template: r8 / rdx), a nop sits between cmpq and jne, and the three spills come in another order (rbx, r9, rdi vs rdi, r9, rbx). Root 2 (90-): the receiver is reloaded into rdx, the capacity test is `cmp %r9,%rcx; jb` with a reload from the stack. An encode mode would need a register-parametric template or several templates; this is an observation from reading the .S, not a measured cost.

claims_and_limits: One out-of-sample case per type (ValidatorIndex, BeaconBlockHeader). No generator-superiority claim. No causal speed-up claim from types of unequal size.
P1 development instances are identical modulo labels; ValidatorIndex is too (only the format-string offset differs from CommitteeIndex). A ValidatorIndex success predicts little (AU-09 C-03).

Kind parameters (indices, displacements, offsets) are generator-read and checked only through the proof's code facts. The P2 decode kind has no hand-theorem anchor. A _kind identity is not a non-vacuity witness (the witnesses are WitVi, WitBhA).

SizeSSZ is excluded from the hold-out claim; AU-09 exposure (phase1c SizeSSZ proofs, IR entries and generated Go already in the repository; one phase1c code-constant line naming a BeaconBlockHeader symbol printed in session 1).
The generator has no encode mode; the MarshalSSZTo fast path is hand work (iii).
AU-07 stays open (encode template net-negative in build time).
The BBH composition and head are adapted texts of the reviewed AttestationData hand proofs; most of the low cost comes from that reuse and from the generated segments, not from the generator alone.
Rebuild tracking: prysm/go1.26.10/e2e/bh/link/norm is not a Lake input_dir (no lakefile change); a .S change would not trigger a rebuild. The link bundle binds the files.
Runtime contracts MakesliceC / MemmoveC (S + 8) stay hypotheses; Slot and ValidatorIndex callees are discharged by proved function specs (no callee contract).
